Quantifying a small gap and then supplying a biological explanation is a fail.

They claim the primary answer reflects the largest difference, in severe stratum, which is clinically meaningful. They do not challenge the premise that sex has no effect; they actually present differences and claim clinically meaningful. They do not show that difference is noise or that men respond higher overall. They do not challenge the premise; they accept it and give numbers. So this is a FAIL. So pass false.
